newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish company to build flour mill in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Turkish company to build flour mill in Egypt.

text.p: Turkey's Ittifak Makina AS, a subsidiary of Ittifak Holding, will build a flour mill in Egypt which will process 60 tonnes of wheat daily, company officials said on Thursday.

They said the project, agreed during Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's visit of some African countries including Egypt last week, would be built near Tanta town in four to five months, but they declined to say how much the deal was worth.
They did not give other information.
Ittifak owns two flour mills in the central Turkish province of Konya, Turkey's breadbasket.
